text: Maya Hawke set to join Magic: The Gathering movie. Maya Hawke is trending after reports said she has been set to join the live-action Magic: The Gathering movie from Legendary Entertainment and Hasbro. The reports were published by Deadline and The Hollywood Reporter.. Hawke is best known for playing Robin Buckley on the Netflix series Stranger Things, which ended last year. Her other credits include Inside Out 2, Asteroid City and Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. The film is based on the trading card game that launched in 1993. Matt Johnson is set to direct, and he is also writing the script with Noah Gardner and Aidan Fitzgerald. Legendary and Hasbro plan a wider film and television universe built on the game. Hawke's next projects include The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping and the Netflix series God of the Woods.

Al Horford removed from Warriors injury report with back issue. Al Horford is trending after he was removed from the Warriors' injury report, a listing of players who may miss games because of injury, on Thursday. The removal came with a back injury.. Warriors reportedly withholding payments to Kristaps Porziņģis, sources say.. Al Horford, a Golden State Warriors player, was taken off the team's injury report on Thursday. The listing had been tied to a back injury. Removal from the report generally means a player is expected to be available. Horford's name drew attention alongside news about teammate Kristaps Porziņģis.
